[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/TEMPLATE.md#opening--context-duration]

#### Opening & Context ([Duration])

**Objectives:**

- Establish workshop purpose and expected outcomes
- Align participants on agenda and ground rules
- Create psychological safety for open participation

**Activities:**

1. **Welcome & Introductions** (10 minutes)

    - Brief round-robin introductions if participants don't know each other
    - State name, role, and one expectation for the workshop

2. **Workshop Charter Review** (10 minutes)

    - Review objectives, success criteria, and agenda
    - Confirm scope and boundaries
    - Address any questions or concerns

3. **Ground Rules & Working Agreements** (10 minutes)
    - Establish participation guidelines (e.g., all voices heard, no side conversations)
    - Technology guidelines (phones, laptops, notifications)
    - Decision-making approach and conflict resolution

**Materials Needed:**

- Workshop charter printouts
- Name tents or badges
- Flipchart paper and markers for ground rules

**Facilitator Notes:**

- Set energetic, positive tone
- Watch for signs of disengagement or resistance
- Capture any scope clarifications or concerns in parking lot

[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/TEMPLATE.md#action-planning--next-steps-duration]

#### Action Planning & Next Steps ([Duration])

**Objectives:**

- Convert workshop outputs into concrete action items
- Establish ownership and timelines for follow-up work
- Define success metrics and review checkpoints

**Activities:**

1. **Action Item Generation** (20 minutes)

    - Review workshop deliverables and decisions
    - Identify specific actions needed to implement outcomes
    - Define SMART action items (Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, Time-bound)

2. **Ownership Assignment** (15 minutes)

    - Assign primary owner for each action item
    - Identify supporting resources and stakeholders
    - Confirm capacity and commitment from owners

3. **Timeline & Milestones** (15 minutes)

    - Establish realistic deadlines for each action item
    - Identify dependencies and sequencing
    - Schedule follow-up check-ins and reviews

4. **Success Metrics** (10 minutes)
    - Define how success will be measured
    - Establish review timeline and process
    - Identify potential obstacles and mitigation strategies

**Materials Needed:**

- Action item tracking template
- Calendar for scheduling follow-ups
- Contact information for all participants

**Deliverable:**

- Completed action item tracker with owners, timelines, and success metrics
page_texts.22:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/TEMPLATE.md#closing--evaluation-duration]

#### Closing & Evaluation ([Duration])

**Objectives:**

- Summarize key outcomes and decisions
- Capture participant feedback for continuous improvement
- Reinforce commitments and next steps

**Activities:**

1. **Workshop Summary** (10 minutes)

    - Review key decisions made
    - Highlight major deliverables created
    - Confirm action items and commitments

2. **Feedback Collection** (10 minutes)

    - Distribute workshop evaluation forms
    - Conduct brief verbal feedback round (one word describing the workshop)
    - Capture suggestions for improvement

3. **Commitment Confirmation** (10 minutes)
    - Have each action item owner verbally confirm their commitment
    - Address any final questions or concerns
    - Provide contact information for follow-up questions

**Materials Needed:**

- Workshop evaluation forms
- Summary slide or handout
- Business cards or contact list

### Immediate Follow-up (1-3 days)

**Facilitator Responsibilities:**

- [ ] **Session Documentation**: Capture detailed workshop notes and outcomes
- [ ] **Photo Documentation**: Document flip charts, whiteboards, and sticky note clusters (with permission)

**Participant Responsibilities:**

- [ ] **Feedback Submission**: Complete workshop evaluation forms

- [ ] **Resource Sharing**: Provide any additional materials promised during workshop
- [ ] **Calendar Booking**: Schedule follow-up meetings and check-ins

page_texts.40:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/TEMPLATE.md#pre-workshop-issues]

### Pre-Workshop Issues

**Low Participation/Commitment:**

- **Problem**: Key stakeholders not attending or not engaged
- **Solution**: Executive sponsor engagement, clear value proposition, flexible scheduling
- **Prevention**: Early stakeholder engagement, clear communication of importance

**Insufficient Preparation:**

- **Problem**: Participants arrive unprepared or without required materials
- **Solution**: Day-of catch-up session, modified agenda to include preparation time
- **Prevention**: Clear pre-work communication, reminder messages, preparation checklists
page_texts.41:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/TEMPLATE.md#during-workshop-issues]

### During Workshop Issues

**Dominating Personalities:**

- **Problem**: One or two people monopolizing discussion
- **Solution**: Structured turn-taking, small group breakouts, direct facilitation intervention
- **Prevention**: Clear ground rules, diverse activity formats, proactive facilitation

**Scope Creep:**

- **Problem**: Discussion expanding beyond workshop objectives
- **Solution**: Parking lot for off-topic items, agenda time checks, objective reminders
- **Prevention**: Clear scope definition, strong workshop charter, disciplined facilitation

**Technology Failures:**

- **Problem**: Equipment malfunctions disrupting workshop flow
- **Solution**: Switch to analog methods, use backup equipment, modify activities
- **Prevention**: Technology testing, backup plans, analog alternatives ready

**Conflict or Disagreement:**

- **Problem**: Unproductive conflict between participants
- **Solution**: Structured conflict resolution, neutral facilitation, focus on objectives
- **Prevention**: Clear ground rules, stakeholder pre-alignment, skilled facilitator
page_texts.42:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/TEMPLATE.md#post-workshop-issues]

### Post-Workshop Issues

**Low Action Item Follow-through:**

- **Problem**: Participants not completing committed actions
- **Solution**: Individual check-ins, obstacle identification, resource provision
- **Prevention**: Realistic commitments, clear ownership, regular check-ins

**Outcome Implementation Delays:**

- **Problem**: Workshop decisions not being implemented as planned
- **Solution**: Executive sponsor intervention, resource reallocation, priority clarification
- **Prevention**: Executive sponsorship, resource planning, implementation timeline

[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/TEMPLATE.md#adapting-this-template]

### Adapting This Template

This master template is designed to be customized for specific workshop types and organizational needs. Follow these guidelines:

**Essential Elements (Do Not Remove):**

- Workshop overview and objectives
- Pre-workshop planning checklist
- Detailed agenda with time allocations
- Post-workshop follow-up activities
- Success measurement framework

**Customizable Elements:**

- Specific activities and facilitation techniques
- Duration and agenda timing
- Participant roles and numbers
- Materials and setup requirements
- Deliverable formats and content
page_texts.45:
[resources/work-templates/assets/workshop/TEMPLATE.md#workshop-type-variations]

### Workshop Type Variations

**Architecture & Design Workshops:**

- Emphasize technical deliverables and design artifacts
- Include architecture review checkpoints
- Focus on technical stakeholder alignment

**Strategic Planning Workshops:**

- Emphasize business outcomes and strategic alignment
- Include environmental scanning and trend analysis
- Focus on executive-level decision making

**Stakeholder Collaboration Workshops:**

- Emphasize relationship building and communication
- Include consensus-building activities
- Focus on cross-functional alignment

**Innovation & Problem-Solving Workshops:**

- Emphasize creative problem-solving techniques
- Include ideation and prototyping activities
- Focus on breakthrough thinking and innovation
